name: RECOIL-v2
mechanism: Rotor/oracle separation: the byte-rotor (R2/R13) and the oracle-truth decision (does this response attest TRUE/FALSE?) are structurally decoupled — the rotor may change probe bytes freely, but the oracle verdict is derived from a fixed, rotor-independent mapping of the 3D delta to truth. This guarantees the rotor's byte-noise can never corrupt what the oracle concludes.
what_it_does_previous_couldnt: As the rotor grew, a risk emerged that a rotated probe's incidental byte changes could perturb the response in a way the oracle misread as a delta. Decoupling makes the oracle a pure, rotor-invariant function of the state vector — byte-exploration is safe BY CONSTRUCTION, never by luck of the draw.
fireback: The operator can now stress-test by cranking the rotor to its max degree and watching oracle truth hold steady because the verdict path never sees the rotor bytes. Fireback = the operator's attempts to break the oracle through byte-noise fail deterministically, proving the separation isn't a hope but an invariant.
containment: Oracle truth is computed solely from in-scope state vectors (length/status/timing) of bundled fixtures; rotor bytes never feed the truth function; allowlist resolver re-validates every probe destination; marker-gated.
kill_switch: --rotor-0 pins rotation to identity for forensic replay; a rotor-fuzz counter caps how many rotor draws may precede a single oracle verdict; wipe clears oracle-state artifacts.
novelty_angle: Exploration (rotor) and evaluation (oracle) are made information-disjoint — the campaign can explore an unbounded byte space without ever risking its own judgment. A correctness invariant, not a config knob, is the mechanism here.
